newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Banco do Brasil offers proposal to absorb losses.
newsitem.headline: Banco do Brasil offers proposal to absorb losses.

text.p: Brazil's federal bank Banco do Brasil will present stockholders with a proposal to reduce 65.7 percent of its social capital to absorb accumulated losses of 11.2 billion reais ($10.6 billion), the bank said.
Under the proposal, Banco do Brasil's social capital will fall to 5.58 billion reais from the current 16.31 billion reais, the bank said in a statement.
The bank hopes to remove distortions in its balance sheet caused by what it called "structural losses." It did not elaborate.
The bank said the measure would not change its net worth of 5.59 billion reais.
Banco do Brasil stockholders are expected to vote on the proposal at a meeting on April 23.
